import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Extract features and target
id_col = "id"
target_col = "target"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col].values.astype(float)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

print(f"Feature columns ({len(feature_cols)}): {feature_cols}")

# Identify categorical vs numerical columns
num_cols = []
cat_cols = []

for col in feature_cols:
    # Skip if any NaNs in this column
    if X_train[col].isna().any():
        continue
    if (
        pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X_train[col])
        or str(X_train[col].dtype) == "float64"
        or str(X_train[col].dtype) == "int64"
    ):
        num_cols.append(col)
    elif (
        X_train[col].dtype == "object"
        or str(X_train[col].dtype) == "<U64"
        or str(X_train[col].dtype) == "str"
    ):
        cat_cols.append(col)

print(f"Numerical columns: {num_cols}")
print(f"Categorical columns: {cat_cols}")

# Prepare preprocessing
numeric_transformer = Pipeline([("scaler", StandardScaler())])

categorical_transformer = Pipeline(
    [("encoder", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"))]
)

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        ("num", numeric_transformer, num_cols),
        ("cat", categorical_transformer, cat_cols),
    ]
)

# Apply preprocessor
X_processed_train = preprocessor.transform(X_train[feature_cols])
X_processed_test = preprocessor.transform(X_test[feature_cols])

# Split for validation (use subset of training data only)
X_val, X_train_final, y_val, y_train_final = train_test_split(
    X_processed_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Validation set size: {X_val.shape[0]}")
print(f"Training set size: {X_train_final.shape[0]}")

# Create a simple classifier with tuned hyperparameters
clf = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "model",
            xgb.XGBClassifier(
                n_estimators=500,
                max_depth=6,
                learning_rate=0.05,
                random_state=42,
                eval_metric="logloss",
                use_label_encoder=False,
                subsample=0.8,
                colsample_bytree=0.8,
                min_child_weight=3,
                gamma=0.1,
            ),
        )
    ]
)

# Train on training data ONLY (never touch validation)
clf.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Predict on validation (held out during training)
val_proba = clf.named_steps["model"].predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation ROC-AUC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_proba = clf.named_steps["model"].predict_proba(X_processed_test)[:, 1]

# Format predictions: extract only IDs from test, match to prediction order
test_ids = list(test_df[id_col])
predictions = {"id": test_ids, "target": test_proba}
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(predictions)

# Use sample_submission for exact formatting
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
print(f"Total predictions made: {len(submission_df)}")
